reason: Cline preparation blocked: Not an engineering request against this repository. Issue #53 is an auto-generated bounty notification produced by this repo's own bot template (bounty_bot.py -> crear_notificacion). Its entire body is the bot payload and links only to an external listing: https://github.com/zhangjiayang6835-cyber/bounty-plaza/issues/4143, titled '[Bounty] Preserve RFC 7239 `Forwarded` host authority in sub-mounted ASGI `Request.scope_'. The referenced change belongs to Starlette (`starlette/requests.py` in the author's comment patch), which does not exist here. The alfrexo95/bounty-bot checkout at the base SHA contains only the bounty-scraping bot: bounty_bot.py, search_web3_bounties.py, requirements.txt (requests, dbgagent), seen_issues.json, seen_web3.json, and two scheduled notification workflows (.github/workflows/bot.yml, web3_bounties.yml). grep -rin 'starlette|Forwarded|forwarded|requests.py|asgi|scope' over all *.py/*.yml/*.txt returns zero matches. There is no test, build, or lint infrastructure (no pyproject.toml, setup.py, setup.cfg, tox.ini, pytest.ini, Makefile, or tests). No PR targets issue #53; the two open PRs (#55 for issue #54, #34 for issue #21) are AI-agent PRs against sibling auto-generated bounty issues. Funding is an unverified escrow claim in the notification body ('Verifica que el escrow esté activo antes de trabajar'); no escrow mechanism exists in this repository. Therefore this is a marketplace/bounty listing with no reproducible defect and no concrete code change for this repository. Checkout left unchanged at the base SHA.
